title: CLAUDE.md
text: ggml assertion may reach abort(). Arguments ggml asserts validated first; remains caught abort callback shim (design §13.2). test reaches assertion bug. Nothing ggml pool thread calls R. main thread touches R objects; errors cross status codes. Never write compiler flag Makevars, never compile ggml source directly. Every ggml source goes zlm_v/ wrapper, applies zlm_compat.h (stdio, abort _Exit may linked) ISA pragmas. Regenerate tools/gen-build. variant’s shared object never unloaded. Objects created finalised code; R/load.R keeps every loaded variant, store made one variant zulm_stale_error another. C code raises R errors zlm_raise(), freeing memory. zlm_raise() longjmps; anything malloc’d ggml gguf context owned protected external pointer leaks. Store tensors never move. store grows batches; never reallocate batch, graphs hold tensors’ addresses. Never allocate graph’s original nodes. zl_forward() runs copy (zlm_dup.cpp); ggml-opt copies inherit data pointers, allocated original make training read reused memory. Every new operation needs validation validate() (zlm_graph.c): ggml asserts builders kernels, kernel assertion compute fatal. f32 enters operations. Results must depend thread count. Reported losses fixed-order sums per-row values random draws come zurand keys, never thread-local generator (design §6.5).

title: Conditions signalled by zulm — zulm-conditions
text: Errors: zulm_invalid_argument: argument wrong kind value. zulm_shape_error: dimensions fit; carries op, shapes R call operation involved. zulm_type_error: tensor value type accepted. zulm_unsupported_backward: operation without gradient gradient path; carries op. zulm_memory_error: allocation beyond getOption("zulm.max_bytes") (4 GiB default); carries requested allowed, bytes. zulm_engine_error: assertion ggml library caught graph built; carries ggml_message. graph discarded. zulm_interrupt: computation stopped user interrupt; also inherits interrupt. zulm_file_error: GGUF safetensors file read written. zulm_arrow_error: Arrow stream unsupported type, null, dictionary stream failure; carries column row. zulm_companion_error: companion package whose interface lacks something zulm needs. zulm_stale_error: object longer valid, restored saved R session created variant longer use. zulm_internal_error: bug zulm. Warnings: zulm_range_warning: values beyond range storage type, became infinite. zulm_nonfinite_warning: training step whose loss finite.

title: zulm 0.0.0.9000
text: First development version: package skeleton family conventions. R interface follows later stages. Bundles CPU subset ‘ggml’ v0.26.0, built per instruction-set level (baseline, sse42 avx2 x86-64, neon arm64); best level CPU supports loaded package, options(zulm.variant =) forces another. zulm_info() reports bundled ‘ggml’ version, variant loaded, CPU features built . Installing source ZULM_CFLAGS ZULM_CXXFLAGS set builds one variant local CPU (Windows). Parameter stores: zl_params(), zl_param() init type ("f32", "f16" "bf16"), zl_param_get(), zl_param_set(), zl_param_names(), zl_param_count() zl_param_tensor(); initialisers zl_init_normal(), zl_init_uniform(), zl_init_zeros() zl_init_ones(), drawing ‘zurand’ key derived parameter’s name. zl_save() zl_load() write read stores GGUF files, metadata, f32, f16 bf16. Every error inherits zulm_error every warning zulm_warning; see ?"zulm-conditions" classes. Allocations checked getOption("zulm.max_bytes") (4 GiB default). Graphs: zl_graph() builds graph R function, zl_int() declares integer inputs, zl_forward() runs number times new inputs, zl_graph_info() describes . Operations tensors inside graph: +, -, *, / broadcasting, zl_scale(), zl_sum(), zl_sum_rows(), zl_mean_rows(), zl_cumsum(), elementwise functions (zl_sqr() zl_tanh(), zl_gelu()), zl_swiglu(), zl_crossprod(), zl_reshape(), zl_permute(), zl_t(), zl_cont(), zl_view(), zl_concat(), zl_pad(), zl_get_rows(), zl_where(), zl_clamp(), zl_tri(), zl_softmax() masks, zl_causal_mask(), zl_rope() conventions, zl_rms_norm(), zl_layer_norm(), losses zl_cross_entropy(), zl_mse() zl_mae(), zl_cast(). Every argument ‘ggml’ assert checked first; assertion still happens graph built zulm_engine_error. ‘ggml’’s log becomes messages class zulm_message, level options(zulm.log =) ("warn" default).
